what_they_do: This company develops mass photometry instruments that measure the mass of single biomolecules in solution in their native state without labels. Their systems are used for characterizing proteins, nucleic acids, AAVs, antibodies, VLPs, and membrane proteins.
technology_approach: Mass photometry measures the light scattered by individual particles landing on a measurement surface; this scattered light interferes with light reflected by the surface, and the interference signal scales linearly with the molecule's mass, enabling single-molecule counting and mass measurement.
sensitivity_claim: For molecular mass measurements with unmatched sensitivity, speed and simplicity of use, a TwoMP mass photometer offers wide mass range and single-molecule resolution.
sample_requirement: Quantifying antibody aggregation at nano- and micromolar sample concentrations with the mass photometry Antibody Stability Module
